title: Are You the Dictator of the Group Chat?
description: Discover your true locus of control in the group chat. Are you the ruler, the peacekeeper, the troll, or the ghost?

questions.text: Setting up a dinner plan. How do you handle it?

choices.label: Send a poll with strict deadlines.
Suggest places and ask for votes.
Spam food memes. 'I'm down for whatever.'
Leave it on read.

questions.text: Two friends are arguing in the chat. You...

choices.label: Tell them to take it to DMs immediately.
Mediate and find a middle ground.
Send popcorn emojis.
Mute the chat for 8 hours.

questions.text: Someone tries to change your carefully made itinerary.

choices.label: Veto it. My plan is final.
Discuss if we can fit it in gracefully.
Agree, then completely forget the new plan.
I didn't even read the itinerary.

questions.text: What's your texting speed and style?

choices.label: Rapid paragraphs, proper punctuation.
Warm, clear texts with emojis.
10 separate messages for one sentence.
... (Silence)

questions.text: The group chat has been dead for 3 days.

choices.label: Tag everyone and demand a roll call.
Drop a friendly 'How's everyone doing?'
Send a cursed TikTok at 3 AM.
Enjoy the peace and quiet.
